known.via: English Wikipedia "Western Cape (wine)" (redirects to "Western Cape wine")

climate: A dry climate, though much of its little rain falls while the vines grow. Water is scarce.

blurb.text: A geographical unit within the Wine of Origin system, matching the Western Cape province and taking in most of South Africa's vineyards. It holds the Coastal Region, Breede River Valley, Cape South Coast, Klein Karoo and Olifants River.
